verdict.rationale: Homebrew has no separate GUI. Its documented CLI is the complete interface and is scriptable for automation: non-interactive install, `brew bundle dump/check/install`, and MDM/root workflows. So agents can drive everything the tool does, but only through shelling out. No OpenAPI spec was found, and the only API reference is a community mention of a Cask JSON API used for metadata. missing for 10: a documented programmatic API (OpenAPI/REST) with parity to the CLI, machine-readable docs (llms.txt), and independent corroboration of API completeness.
